name: Self-storage — climate controlled
summary: Multi-story (typically 3–5 stories) interior-access climate-controlled storage on 1.5–4 acre infill sites. Cost drivers: structural system (steel/PEMB vs. concrete podium), number of stories and elevators, unit-mix partitions and roll-up doors, HVAC, and efficiency (rentable vs gross area ≈ 70–80%). Public evidence is a scatter of announced project costs (Inside Self Storage roundups) whose scope (construction vs total, gross vs rentable) is unclear, plus one vendor cost table; the default is a reasoned midpoint, medium-low confidence.

typicalSize.method: Announced projects 70,000–150,000 SF (e4–e7, e9); converted to NRSF at ~75–85% when the source SF is gross. Mid 85,000 NRSF.

sfPerPrimaryUnit.method: Gross building SF per NRSF = 1 / efficiency. Multi-story interior-access buildings typically 65–85% efficient (corridors, elevators, stairs, office, loading); mid 75% → 1.33 (judgment, industry rule of thumb).

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: Site densities in the announced projects: Riverhead 70,000 SF on 3.3 ac (21k/ac, e5), Katy 150,000 SF on 4 ac (37.5k/ac, e6), Fort Lauderdale 97,862 SF on 1.8 ac (54k/ac, e9), Jacksonville 110,000 SF on 1.8 ac (61k/ac, e4). Treated as rentable SF; mid ≈ 38,000 NRSF/acre for a 3–4 story suburban building.

parkingPerPrimaryUnit.method: Self-storage zoning typically requires ~4–10 spaces per facility plus loading (≈ 1 per 10,000–25,000 NRSF) — judgment.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Per gross SF: vendor table multi-story construction $105–$175 and climate-controlled $80–$125 excluding sitework (e1/e2). Announced projects scatter $55–$58/SF in low-cost TX/FL suburbs (e4/e6, likely building contract only) to $135–$186/SF where the figure is probably total development cost (e5/e7/e8). Hard cost incl. modest sitework taken as ≈ $62–$150 per GSF, mid ≈ $98/GSF (midpoint of the $55–$58 contract values plus ~45% for sitework/GC/full scope, and ~70% of the $135–$150 total-cost figures). × 1.33 GSF/NRSF (75% efficiency) → $130/NRSF mid; low $80 (3-story PEMB in a low-cost market, 80% efficient), high $200 (4–5 story urban/concrete, 65–70% efficient; consistent with e9 loan of $204/SF).

perSF.method: Per gross SF = perPrimaryUnit ÷ sfPerPrimaryUnit (80/1.29, 130/1.33, 200/1.33 rounded); see perPrimaryUnit method.

scope.notes: Contractor price incl. GC/OH&P; building, unit partitions and roll-up doors, HVAC, elevators, security/access hardware, rental office build-out, and typical on-site work (small sites, mostly paving/utilities/detention). Excludes land, soft costs, off-sites, impact fees and operator FF&E/software.

qualityTiers.method: economy ≈ low/mid (80/130 = 0.62) tempered to 0.75; premium 1.25 for 4-story with glass façade/retail-style office; luxury ≈ high/mid (200/130 = 1.54) for 5+ story urban concrete product.

systemSplit.method: No public elemental breakdown found. Judgment split for a 3–4 story steel-framed storage building: structure 03/05 28% (elevated slabs/deck), envelope 07 7%, roll-up unit doors + storefront 08 9%, steel unit partitions/corridor system in 10 7%, elevators 14 3%, climate HVAC 23 7%, sprinklers 4%, electrical/lighting 6%, security/access 28 2%, small-site sitework 31–33 9%, GC 9%. Verify with a self-storage contractor estimate.

cost.method: From _blocks/building-systems.json elevator-hydraulic ($75k/$115k/$160k each). Typical 3–4 story storage building has 2 elevators (judgment).

lineItems.name: Steel unit partitions, corridor system and roll-up unit doors

cost.method: No public unit price fetched. Pre-engineered storage partition and door packages are typically quoted per rentable SF; judgment $9–$18/NRSF depending on unit mix (smaller units = more door and wall per SF).

lineItems.name: Gate/keypad access control, door alarms, CCTV and kiosk

cost.method: Building-systems block: access-control door $1.5k–$4.5k each (e7) and CCTV camera ~$1k–$3k each. Typical facility ≈ 6–12 controlled doors/gates + 25–40 cameras + kiosk/software → $40k–$150k (judgment).
Judgment: two overhead doors, ~1,500–2,500 SF of conditioned loading area at building cost plus canopy/drive apron.

pctOfHard.method: Vendor guide gives soft costs at 15–22% of TOTAL project cost incl. land (e3). That definition includes financing. Removing financing (~5–8 points of total) leaves ~8–15% of total; dividing by a hard-cost share of total of ~55–70% (land 15–30%) gives ≈ 0.12–0.27 of hard. Range set at 0.15–0.28 (small projects carry fixed design/permit costs), mid 0.20 (judgment).

softCosts.notes: Type-specific soft items: market feasibility study, lease-up marketing/digital ads, management-software setup and third-party management onboarding. Financing excluded.

design.method: Repeatable prototype designs keep design contingency moderate (judgment).

perPrimaryUnit.method: min ≈ hard low $80 × 1.08; max ≈ hard high $200 × 1.4 (urban 5-story with full soft costs). Compare e8 total development ≈ $135/SF ≈ $160–$180/NRSF incl. land.

source.title: Self Storage Building Costs in 2026: A Comprehensive Guide

evidence.quote: Cost table rows: 'Climate-controlled' $80-125 per sq ft; 'Multi-story' $105-175 per sq ft. "This cost does not include land or site improvement cost and represents construction costs only."
evidence.scopeNotes: Operator-software vendor blog citing Marcus & Millichap and C&W self-storage surveys without per-figure attribution. Building construction only (no sitework); basis (gross vs rentable SF) not stated — assumed gross.

source.title: Self Storage Building Costs in 2026: A Comprehensive Guide

evidence.quote: Cost table row: 'Climate-controlled' $80-125 per sq ft (construction only, excludes land and site improvement)
evidence.scopeNotes: Same source as e1; single/two-story climate-controlled product.

source.title: Self Storage Building Costs in 2026: A Comprehensive Guide

evidence.quote: Soft costs (architecture, engineering, permitting, insurance, and financing fees) typically run 15-22% of total project cost.
evidence.scopeNotes: Percent of TOTAL project cost including land and financing, not of hard cost.

source.title: Self-Storage Development and Zoning Activity: March 2025

evidence.quote: open a $6.1 million, three-story self-storage facility in Jacksonville, Florida … The 1.8-acre property at 3909 Philips Highway comprises 110,000 square feet in more than 700 climate-controlled and drive-up units.
evidence.scopeNotes: $6.1M / 110,000 SF = $55.45/SF. Unclear whether the $6.1M is construction only or total and whether SF is gross or rentable; low outlier.

source.title: Self-Storage Development and Zoning Activity: March 2025

evidence.quote: developing a self-storage facility on a 3.3-acre parcel in Riverhead, New York for $13 million. The building at 61 Main Road comprises 70,000 square feet in 530 units
evidence.scopeNotes: $13M / 70,000 SF = $185.71/SF; likely total development cost (may include land). High-cost Long Island market.

source.title: Self-Storage Development and Zoning Activity: October 2026

evidence.quote: C3 Katy Ventures is building Freeman Self-Storage in Katy, Texas, for $8.7 million. The three-story facility at 23920 FM 529 will comprise 150,000 square feet in 850 climate-controlled units.
evidence.scopeNotes: $8.7M / 150,000 SF = $58/SF; likely building contract/permit value only; built on 4 of 13 acres.

source.title: Self-Storage Development and Zoning Activity: July 2026

evidence.quote: U-Haul International Inc. … is building a new location in Albuquerque, New Mexico, for $15.7 million. The facility at 8200 Jefferson St. N.E. will comprise 104,787 square feet of climate-controlled space and offer vehicle storage.
evidence.scopeNotes: $15.7M / 104,787 SF = $149.83/SF; scope (land, vehicle-storage area, U-Haul retail) not stated.

source.title: Self-Storage Development and Zoning Activity: August 2026

evidence.quote: Space Shop Self Storage … is developing three facilities in Florida and Virginia for $40 million. Together, they’ll comprise 297,000 square feet in 2,088 units.
evidence.scopeNotes: $40M / 297,000 SF = $134.68/SF; most likely total development cost incl. land and soft costs.

source.title: Self-Storage Development and Zoning Activity: October 2026

evidence.quote: Tarpon River Self Storage on a 1.8-acre site in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. The five-story building … will comprise 97,862 square feet in 1,070 climate-controlled units. The $20 million construction loan
evidence.scopeNotes: Construction LOAN $20M / 97,862 SF = $204/SF — a loan amount (typically 55–70% of total cost), so total cost is higher; urban 5-story South Florida. Used only as an upper-bound indicator; also gives site density (≈54,000 SF/acre).

openQuestions: Announced project costs mix construction-only, total-development and loan amounts; an SSA or Yardi Matrix development-cost survey (public excerpt) would anchor the default.
Gross vs rentable SF basis in news items is unclear; efficiency assumption (75%) drives the $/NRSF figure.
Unit partition/door package and security costs are derived — get vendor (Janus/Trac-Rite/DBCI) budget pricing.
